plugins.name: twikey-payment-xray
plugins.description: The manual work in your payment process, counted from your own exports: failed collections by bank reason code, the 36-month mandate rule, unmatched payments and terms against reality. Then this month's work, prepared: new attempts, customer mail drafts, mandates to renew and match suggestions. Drafts only, nothing is sent. Twikey receives nothing.
